_approach: RYM notes krushclub borrows Sigilkore's 'dark production style' and occult atmosphere. Built around a huge layered clap+snare stack (both roles hit together on 2 and 4 at near-max velocity) over a low, dark tomLow pulse standing in for a detuned sub-kick — the 5-kick Jersey shape is thinned to just beats 1 and 3 so the stack dominates. Hats are sparse, high-passed-implied ghost velocities; no open hat, no shimmer — the low end and the stack are the whole texture. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
